summary: Pin is in steep, dense garden bush with no track or place to stop.
reasons: No track or vehicles reach the pin
Nearest road is narrow gardens road, no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Very secluded in bush, no dwellings, but nowhere a van can get to.
drivers.access_and_room: Only footpaths reach the pin. The gardens road 64 m north has no visible pull-off or car park.
drivers.traffic: Quiet gardens road and herbarium building to the north.
drivers.convention: No sign of parking or overnight use.

flags: Steep: about 13% mean grade, 37% max at pin
Pin is 17 m from a mapped waterway
sun_shade: Under dense tree canopy on all sides.
